gre_general.value: GRE General test is not required or requested centrally for graduate research admission at UCL.

toefl_min.value: UCL sets five levels of English language proficiency; each degree course page confirms which level applies.
toefl_min.quote: See each degree course page to confirm which UCL level of English proficiency you will need to meet.

ielts_min.value: UCL sets five levels of English language proficiency; each degree course page confirms which level applies.
ielts_min.quote: See each degree course page to confirm which UCL level of English proficiency you will need to meet.

english_waiver.value: UCL waives the English test only for degrees completed in an approved majority English-speaking country; degrees from India do not qualify.
english_waiver.quote: This must be in a country that UCL considers to be acceptable for this purpose and the medium of instruction must be English.

notes: Graduate research degrees at UCL include MPhil/PhD programmes across faculties. Most research programmes have rolling admission and no application fee.
